item.title: Muntinlupa City Gets BYD EVs As New Police Patrol Cars
item.description: The City Government of Muntinlupa is the next municipality to go electrified as BYD Cars Philippines turned over eight battery electric patrol cars. The move strengthens local police operations while advancing Muntinlupa Mayor Ruffy Biazon’s green technology program for the city. Read More »

item.title: How does this longtime Mitsubishi Pajero owner feel about the new model?
item.description: I love the Mitsubishi Pajero . I’ve been a fan ever since I first saw one in 1987. I had eyed this one I own for five years before I finally got my hands on it.

item.title: Isle of Man TT confirms full transition from Supertwins to Sportbikes for 2027
item.description: Supertwins and sportbikes will no longer co-exist at the Isle of Man TT, with organisers confirming a full transition to sportbike machinery in 2027.

item.title: Sam Sunderland completes 2,356-mile first leg of world record attempt
item.description: Sam Sunderland has reached Istanbul after covering 2,356 miles in the opening leg of his attempt to break the motorcycle circumnavigation record.
